5×7 oversized convention premium of [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]], signed "Shannon Baksa as Mara Jade / San Diego." Decipher show premium, copyright 2000. Spend $20 at the Decipher convention store.

Fair use of a promotional card photograph for identification on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]], [[Shannon Baksa]], and [[Oversized cards]]. Source: [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-misc_sw_items/mara_jade_oversized_signed_by_shannon_baksa_in_san_diego/97531 CategoryOne Games]. Cataloged: [http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11259 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11259] (Duncan Jenkins, 5×7, 2000).
